description: Manage one of the connected X account's X Chat conversations (id from list_x_chats). For the brand only: 'mute' / 'unmute'; 'delete' removes it from the brand's inbox for good while the others keep theirs (confirm:true). For everyone in it: 'set_disappearing' (disappearAfter like '24h' or '7d'), 'clear_disappearing', 'screen_capture' (blockScreenshots OR notifyOnScreenshot, one per call). GROUPS (id starts with g; the brand must be an admin): 'admin_settings' (adminOnly {addMember, editGroupInfo, sendMessage, startCall, editMessageTtl, blockScreenCapture}; sendMessage:true makes it announcement-only), 'add_admins' / 'remove_admins' (userIds), 'remove_members' (userIds, confirm:true), 'leave' (confirm:true), 'approve_admin_request' / 'reject_admin_request' (userId), 'reject_join_requests' (userIds; APPROVING a join re-keys the encrypted group, so it is done in the X app), 'enable_invite' (optional title, avatarUrl, welcomeMessage, expiresAt; X stores that preview UNENCRYPTED and shows it to anyone with the link), 'disable_invite' (the shared link dies for good: confirm:true). INBOX, for the brand only: 'archive' / 'unarchive', 'mark_read' (may send the other person a read receipt). MESSAGE REQUESTS: 'accept_request' (id = the sender's numeric id, or the request's conversationId from list_x_chats view message_requests) moves the conversation into the inbox; show the user who sent it first (list_x_dms with participantId reads the message only if it was not sent encrypted). Confirm the exact conversation with the user before passing confirm:true; a refusal is free. The answer is X's own yes or no, never an echo. Needs X connected with direct-message access: an X connection made before 2026-08-25 must be reconnected once under Connectors > X (the tool says so without calling X). Costs credits (X bills per call).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

action.description: conversation action; the tool description lists each one and what it needs

addMember.description: admin_settings: true = only admins may add members

blockScreenCapture.description: admin_settings: true = only admins may control screen capture

editGroupInfo.description: admin_settings: true = only admins may edit group info

editMessageTtl.description: admin_settings: true = only admins may change the disappearing-message timer

sendMessage.description: admin_settings: true = only admins may send messages (announcement mode)

startCall.description: admin_settings: true = only admins may start calls

avatarUrl.description: enable_invite: https image for the preview

blockScreenshots.description: screen_capture: true = block screenshots of the chat

confirm.description: true only after the user approved this exact delete / leave / removal / link shutdown

disappearAfter.description: set_disappearing: '24h', '7d', '90m' or a number of seconds

expiresAt.description: enable_invite: ISO 8601 or epoch ms; omit for a link that does not expire

id.description: conversation id from list_x_chats: g + digits for a group, or the other person's numeric id for a 1:1 (accept_request: the sender's numeric id)

notifyOnScreenshot.description: screen_capture: true = notify everyone when someone takes a screenshot

title.description: enable_invite: the group name shown on the link preview (stored unencrypted)

userIds.description: NUMERIC X account ids (add_admins, remove_admins, remove_members, reject_join_requests)

welcomeMessage.description: enable_invite: welcome text on the invite preview; stored unencrypted

name: manage_x_chat
title: Manage an X Chat conversation
